newsitem.title: NORWAY: DnB extends bid for BNbank until Thursday.
newsitem.headline: DnB extends bid for BNbank until Thursday.

text.p: Den norske Bank (DnB), Norway's biggest bank, said on Monday it was extending a takeover bid for mortgage lender BNbank until Thursday.

"Den norske Bank extends the deadline to shareholders in BNbank until Thursday May 15 in order for as many shareholders as possible get the opportunity to accept DnB's bid," it said in a statement to the Oslo Bourse.
It was the second time DnB extended the deadline for its bid, which is offering BNbank shareholders 209 crowns per share, including a 1996 dividend of 10.50 crowns.

DnB first extended its offer on May 2. It was launched last month in competition with a rival bid for BNbank by Fokus Bank. Fokus, Norway's fourth biggest bank, has a share exchange offer valuing BNbank at 2.06 billion crowns.
